audited_items.title: Add explicit overflow behavior.
source_evidence: compiler/anvil.py: numeric expression generation wraps arithmetic results, operands, and all numeric built-in results in anvil_check_number; division checks finite operands/results.
runtime/anvil_runtime.c: anvil_check_number rejects non-finite doubles with source path/line and exit code 2.
tests: tests/test_compiler.py::CompilerTests::test_non_finite_numeric_results_report_source_location: passed for arithmetic overflow, comparison intermediate, and sqrt(-1)
tests/test_compiler.py::CompilerTests::test_accumulation_and_for_step_overflow_report_source_location: passed for local add, local subtract, and for-loop step overflow
tests/test_compiler.py::CompilerTests::test_udp_nan_receive_reports_source_location: passed end-to-end by sending an IEEE NaN UDP payload and checking source path/line and exit code 2
tests/test_compiler.py::CompilerTests::test_udp_finite_receive_and_missing_socket_remain_supported: passed finite 42.5 payload and unavailable-socket zero behavior
audited_items.missing_or_limitations: Item #47 behavior passed independent review on c5d7d40. Overall QA scored 89/100, below the required 98/100 bar, so broader evaluation work continues and another overall review is pending. This detects non-finite results but does not prevent every finite precision loss or integer-style wraparound because Anvil uses double values.
acceptance_criteria: Define overflow/non-finite runtime behavior.
Report the Anvil source path and line and exit deterministically.
Cover direct overflow, non-finite intermediates used in comparisons, and invalid math results.
Document the behavior and get independent review.
audited_items.verification_result: COMPLETE: the 61-test suite, extension validation, Python/JSON/diff checks, MSVC numeric demo, and independent review of c5d7d40 pass for item #47. The review scored 89/100 overall and found no code defect in this behavior. Issue #30 is resolved; stale workflow wording remains tracked under issue #31.
